study.question: Does the incumbent fifth match channel benefit from its sample-dependent norm matching, its inherited joint-moment support gate, or their interaction, and can releasing that gate improve validation click AUC at identical model capacity?
study.hypothesis: Observation: g0-r0016-joint_ordered AUC0.6656437663 did not exceed duplicate_match0.6657390847; scrambled0.6654459194 and duplicate_curvature0.6654868493 also lagged. The fifth coefficient in duplicate_match is parallel to the first match coefficient, but multiplies it by sqrt(position_norm2/match_norm2) and a sample-dependent joint-support gate. Its +0.0001320169 over g0-r0014-curvature_task0.6656070679 is confounded by +7168 parameters and this changed scale/support. Source inspection shows the gate requires nondegenerate ordered and scrambled interaction residuals and nonzero quadratic coefficients; it can suppress valid match summaries when these unrelated moments are absent. Hypothesis: norm matching stabilizes a sparse exact-match correction, while the joint gate unnecessarily removes useful histories. Replacing it by match-and-position availability should improve click AUC, especially outside the long-history cohort, with no added parameters. This is a provisional implementation hypothesis, not support for a new coefficient direction or a priority claim. Local history: compressed task querying underperformed event querying in r0006; field-disaggregated and multiplicative-interaction branches in r0010/r0011 did not beat simpler match/duplicate alternatives. Ordered block/quadratic summaries improved over their replacements in r0013/r0014 and task routing exceeded shared in r0015; all are single-seed observations. No execution failures are reported in the supplied index; these unsuccessful mechanisms remain evidence, not failures to execute. Latest knowledge usage declared EST/HeMix/UniMixer considered rather than adopted; the executed r0016 local moment test did not establish the proposed joint interaction or refute any external architecture.

nearest_work.difference: Primary archived DIN v4 text lines271-282 explicitly discusses retaining interest intensity by omitting softmax. We retain its learned unnormalized local activation, but intervene on a separate fixed, signed, within-block exact-match residual channel, crossing Euclidean norm matching with support gating; this is not softmax attention and does not reproduce DIN exactly. Normalization and intensity are existing concerns; novelty remains unverified.

We preserve the thirty compressed slots and task adapters and only change the scale/support of one signed match channel. No UniMixer component is imported; inspecting the benchmark code does not establish equivalence to the original method.

inherited_components: Full frozen inputs, scoring, labels and host training recipe; released official_offline feedback visibility, including its maturity limitation
Incumbent embeddings and action-aware unnormalized scorer, uniform click route and feedback-stratified auxiliary route
Exact-match exclusions for padding/OOV on item_id/cate_id/brand; centered match, local position, coarse linear and quadratic summaries
Four zero-ended width16 residual adapters with task routing and original gradient ownership; same module creation order and RNG handling
All old ordered/scrambled joint residual calculations retained to construct the inherited gate and keep computation comparable
study.proposed_difference: Define M=the inherited within-block centered mean exact-match coefficient, P=the inherited centered within-block position coefficient, gJ=the existing joint-support gate, gA=1[||M||^2>1e-10 and ||P||^2>1e-10]. Fifth coefficient is M*s*g, where s=sqrt(||P||^2/max(||M||^2,1e-10)) for norm and s=1 for raw; g is gA or gJ. Build all four alternatives in FP32 for every cell and select one, retaining the same five-summary contraction and residual inputs. available_norm is the candidate; joint_norm is a same-seed bridge to the incumbent, available_raw is a nearly exact duplicate-first-channel capacity control (except the predeclared numerical availability threshold), and joint_raw completes the2x2 factorial. No additional moment or task token is introduced. Ordinals are array positions, never elapsed time. Only candidate modules and proposal are editable; no data, host code, scorer, loss or knowledge snapshot is changed.
predictions: Primary directional prediction: available_norm click AUC exceeds joint_norm and available_raw under the fixed host recipe. Improvement over both frozen sources0.6606469405/0.6601633627 is also reported, but incumbent and matched controls are the meaningful current comparators.

Support effect is AUC(available_norm)-AUC(joint_norm), independently contrasted at raw scaling. Scale effect is AUC(available_norm)-AUC(available_raw), independently contrasted under joint support. Report the difference of support effects across scales as a descriptive interaction without treating AUC as an additive per-user mechanism.
joint_norm should reproduce the archived incumbent operator and source initialization; its same-seed rerun is an implementation bridge and cost calibration, not an independent repetition.

gA contains gJ support; the newly exposed coefficient is zero for empty or coefficient-degenerate histories, finite for all masks, and normalized to ||P|| where active. Raw available repeats M on its support; padding values and target action must not affect any coefficient or masked summary.

Predeclared host-available history bins empty,1-16,17-64,>64 will report sample/positive/negative counts and all supplied metrics. The support-release hypothesis predicts a larger gain outside >64 than inside; this is exploratory across trained models and not guaranteed by support inclusion. No custom slicing feedback is requested unless separately authorized.

Identical learned parameter count expected in all cells:32129765 total,31793216 embedding,336549 dense. Runtime should remain near the last four full units329-335s; all four alternatives are evaluated in every cell. Host measurements, not this estimate, determine cost claims.
falsifiers: If available_norm does not exceed joint_norm, the directional claim that releasing the inherited gate is useful is unsupported for this implementation. If joint_norm wins, retain evidence that gating may regularize; do not call gate release successful.

If norm does not beat raw at the same support, the useful-rescaling claim is unsupported. If only raw available improves, proceed with the simpler duplication/capacity account rather than claiming normalization support.

If neither scale nor support effects distinguish matched cells and all beat the smaller four-channel predecessor, capacity/optimization remains a sufficient explanation; the old joint-moment mechanism remains unsupported.

Failure of bridge parity, finite masked outputs/backward, unchanged parameter ownership or fixed-protocol checks is an implementation/integrity failure requiring correction before interpreting quality. Missing host diagnostics are missing evidence, not a negative result.
A single-seed improvement without paired repetitions is preliminary. No significance, repeatability, production point-in-time validity or novelty follows from it.

Changing scale changes optimization as well as information; a fixed-gain control would be needed to distinguish adaptive scale from generic conditioning
Changing support changes both available signal and selective regularization; this factorial estimates their operational effect, not a unique psychological explanation

The first four summaries, learned adapters, shared context and frozen auxiliary gradient constraints may explain the task interactions; task routing is held fixed rather than reattributed here

Auxiliary-label semantics and official_offline visibility limit external transfer. DIN has higher auxiliary AUCs than the click-selected incumbent: all four AUC/Logloss and auxiliary mean must be retained
